notes.title: Announcement about Chacara
notes.notes: Chacara will be released in about two weeks, the game is currently 98%-99% ready, I'm currently polishing features and fixing bugs. The game reached 100 wishlist, which may not seem like much (and it probably is), but I feel very proud, I've been trying very hard and I hope I can deliver a good game to you. Chacara will be available in a variety of languages, have full controller support, and will be priced at US$2.99 ​​(minus a 10% launch discount, price may be cheaper depending on your country).
